scope: 40 seed DRAFT_READY only; all74 NEEDS_REVIEW excluded; no335 bulk generation

selection.name: 벤치프레스
selection.pose_description: Lying on a flat bench, feet on floor, both hands gripping a barbell above mid chest, elbows bent in a controlled bench press.

selection.name: 랫풀다운
selection.pose_description: Seated under a high cable pulley, thighs under support pads, hands on a wide bar, pulling bar toward upper chest in front of the head.

selection.name: 덤벨 컬
selection.pose_description: Standing, elbows close to ribs, palms up, curling two dumbbells toward shoulders.

selection.name: 레그 익스텐션
selection.pose_description: Seated against the back pad of a leg-extension MACHINE, knees aligned with machine pivot, extending both knees against a padded roller in front of lower shins. Side view.

selection.name: 푸시업
selection.pose_description: Standard floor push-up, toes and palms on floor, body straight from heels to head, hands beneath shoulders, elbows bent at bottom. Side view.

selection.name: 시티드 로우
selection.pose_description: Seated with knees slightly bent, feet on foot plates, torso upright, pulling a low cable handle toward abdomen without leaning back.

selection.name: 오버헤드 프레스
selection.pose_description: Standing strict barbell overhead press in FRONT of head, feet planted, pressing bar from upper chest overhead with no leg drive.

selection.name: 플랭크
selection.pose_description: Forearms and toes on floor, elbows beneath shoulders, body straight and parallel to floor, holding position.

selection.name: 덤벨 플라이
selection.pose_description: Lying on a FLAT bench, holding one dumbbell in each hand, arms opened wide with softly bent elbows at chest height. Show the flat bench unmistakably. Three-quarter side view.

selection.name: 풀업
selection.pose_description: Hanging from a pull-up bar with overhand grip, lifting chin above bar, feet off floor, back view.

selection.name: 덤벨 킥백
selection.pose_description: Torso hinged forward, upper arms along torso, extending elbows backward with dumbbells. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 시티드 레그 컬
selection.pose_description: Seated with thighs secured by pad, heels over ankle roller, bending BOTH knees to pull roller downward under seat.

selection.name: 딥스
selection.pose_description: On parallel dip bars, feet off floor, elbows bent, torso leaning slightly forward between bars.

selection.name: 인버티드 로우
selection.pose_description: Body straight beneath a fixed low bar, heels on floor, pulling chest up toward bar. Use equipment: fixed horizontal bar. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 덤벨 프론트 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing, raising load FORWARD to shoulder height with softly bent elbows. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 스쿼트
selection.pose_description: Barbell back squat, standing with a barbell resting on upper back, feet shoulder-width apart, hips and knees bent in a squat.

selection.name: 덤벨 풀오버
selection.pose_description: Lying lengthwise on a flat bench, holding ONE dumbbell with both hands, moving weight in an arc behind head with slightly bent elbows.

selection.name: 매달리기
selection.pose_description: Dead hang from horizontal bar, arms fully extended overhead, feet off floor, not performing a pull-up.

selection.name: 케이블 푸시다운
selection.pose_description: Standing facing high cable pulley, elbows kept at sides, pressing a straight cable bar downward by extending elbows.

selection.name: 스탠딩 카프 레이즈
selection.pose_description: Standing with knees straight on a step, raising heels high onto forefeet, no external weights.

selection.name: 펙덱 플라이 머신
selection.pose_description: Seated upright in a pec-deck machine, elbows softly bent, bringing machine handles together in front of chest.

selection.name: 데드리프트
selection.pose_description: Conventional barbell deadlift from floor, feet hip-width, hands outside knees, hips hinged and back neutral, bar close to shins.

selection.name: 페이스풀
selection.pose_description: Standing facing a cable machine, holding a rope attachment with both hands, pulling rope ends to either side of the face with elbows elevated.

selection.name: 사이드 플랭크
selection.pose_description: Side plank on one forearm and outer edge of feet, elbow under shoulder, hips lifted, body in a straight line.

selection.name: 시티드 덤벨 숄더 프레스
selection.pose_description: Seated upright on a bench with upright back support, feet on floor, pressing TWO DUMBBELLS above shoulders, elbows under wrists. Front three-quarter view.

selection.name: 바벨 컬
selection.pose_description: Standing, elbows beside ribs, bending elbows to curl load upward. Palms face upward. Use equipment: barbell. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 수평 레그 프레스
selection.pose_description: Seated upright in horizontal leg press machine, feet on platform in front, extending hips and knees to push platform horizontally.

selection.name: 크런치
selection.pose_description: Lying on back on floor, knees bent and feet planted, lifting shoulder blades slightly off floor without a full sit-up.

selection.name: 덤벨 슈러그
selection.pose_description: Standing with arms straight down holding load, elevating shoulders toward ears without bending elbows. Use equipment: two dumbbells. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 힙 브릿지
selection.pose_description: Lying on back on floor, knees bent, feet planted, lifting hips while shoulders stay on floor.

selection.name: 러시안 트위스트
selection.pose_description: Seated on floor with knees bent, torso leaned back, both hands together rotating torso to one side, no external weight.

selection.name: 러닝
selection.pose_description: Running on level ground with an unmistakable running stride, bent elbows, no treadmill or machine.

selection.name: 덤벨 해머 컬
selection.pose_description: Standing, elbows beside ribs, curling two dumbbells with neutral thumb-up grip maintained throughout.

selection.name: 스텝업
selection.pose_description: One foot on stable box, stepping upward by extending planted leg while other foot rises from floor.

selection.name: 복근 롤아웃
selection.pose_description: Kneeling on floor with both hands gripping an ab wheel, rolling wheel forward while extending hips and arms without arching back.

selection.name: 로잉
selection.pose_description: Seated on a rowing ergometer with feet strapped into foot plates, knees extending, pulling handle to lower ribs; entire rowing machine visible.

selection.name: 사이드 런지
selection.pose_description: Wide lateral step, bending stepping-leg knee while other leg remains straight. Use equipment: floor. Full body and equipment visible.

selection.name: 마운틴 클라이머
selection.pose_description: High plank on palms and toes, drawing one knee toward chest with opposite leg extended.

selection.name: 줄넘기
selection.pose_description: Standing in mid rope skip, holding a rope handle in each hand with a continuous rope arc under feet.

selection.name: 트레드밀
selection.pose_description: Running on a motorized treadmill belt, upright body, natural alternating leg stride and bent arms. Entire treadmill is inside the cell.
